input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including user, intention, customer, intention task. The platform provides capabilities for position api, redis lock, intention. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage intention records, so that I can track and organize intention data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage customer records, so that I can track and organize customer data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage intention task records, so that I can track and organize intention task data effectively.
